title: neurolepis nobilis
intro: Neurolepis nobilis, commonly known as Mountain Pepper, is a plant species native to Australia, belonging to the family Rutaceae. It has been traditionally used by the Indigenous people of Australia for various purposes, including medicinal and culinary uses. The health benefits of Neurolepis nobilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and limonoids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
